reuse.why: Follows the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked precondition pattern with one new shared guard; there is no single common link entry point in this tree to hook into.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; the only repetition is the one-line guard call added to each of the six provider link functions, mirroring the existing assert call.

placement.why: The guard sits beside the existing link precondition in accounts/app.ts and runs before any bank, account or sync work.

scope.why: One helper, six one-line calls and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and consistent, but a future provider must remember to call both asserts since the providers do not share a link wrapper.

one_place.where: assertUpgradingAccountOpen in server/accounts/app.ts is the single definition, called by all six provider link handlers (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Fintegra, Enable Banking).
